method: Built-in image generation followed by a vector adaptation for Android.
selectedConceptPrompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: original Android launcher icon concept for Kaptus, an English caption companion for people who are hard of hearing. Kaptus briefly listens to a movie or TV episode, finds the right subtitle line, then quietly displays synchronized captions. Create one standalone square icon artwork, not a contact sheet and not a phone mockup. Full-bleed background to all four square edges; do not pre-round the canvas corners or draw an enclosing app-tile border. Keep the important symbol large, centered within the middle 68 percent of the canvas, composed to survive circular launcher cropping and remain recognizable at 48 pixels. Exceptionally refined visual identity; concept exploration, memorable and original. No app name, no written text, no numbers, no signature, no watermark. Invent a beautiful compact origami bird app icon in profile, its folded body deliberately shaped like a quotation mark, and its lifted wing bearing two broad negative-space caption slits. Off-white and rich persimmon-orange paper facets, dark teal background. Delicate intelligence but bold broad facets, one subtle paper fold shadow only. Rounded approachable beak, balanced upward pose, no legs or scene, no text or envelopes. This must read as a singular designer brand mark.
circularBadgeRefinementPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied Kaptus Wordbird icon, which the user has selected as the brand. Preserve the exact bird design: right-facing ivory paper-folded head and curved body, large upward orange wing with two dark caption-shaped apertures, orange triangular beak and folded orange tail. Preserve the silhouette, pose, proportions, paper facets, orange/ivory palette, and subtle paper texture; do not redesign or add eyes or limbs. Clean the ragged transparency matte and colored fringe around the silhouette into sharp beautifully antialiased edges. Place this same bird optically centered inside one perfectly circular, solid medium-deep teal field (#176B70), with plenty of breathing space: the bird occupies about 67 percent of the circle's height and never touches the edge. The bird should look like a distinctive artful origami brand character, never a generic caption logo. The circle nearly fills the square canvas and is fully visible. Everything OUTSIDE the circle must be genuinely transparent, never black and never white. The circle is flat colored teal, not almost-black; no gradient, no enclosing outline, no shadow around the circle, no lettering, no wordmark, no new icon elements. Produce the finished isolated circular badge as one square PNG.

approvedProductionRevision.decision: Use the in-app cinema yellow on the bird while keeping its ivory body and teal circle.
